title: ValidationEvent
description: Schema for ValidationEvent objects — records of validation actions performed on graph entities, relations, SourceQuote objects, or Claims. Enables tracking of who validated what, when, and with what result. Provisional workspace-layer format; not yet wired to canonical graph.

targetId.description: ID of the entity, relation, SourceQuote, or Claim being validated.

targetName.description: Human-readable name of the validated object (for quick identification).

validator.description: Name or identifier of the person or agent performing validation.

validatorType.description: Whether the validator is a human, AI agent, or automated script.

scope.description: What aspect of the target was validated. Examples: 'quoteText accuracy', 'page number', 'relation type', 'entity classification'.

result.description: Outcome of validation. 'confirmed' = valid as-is. 'corrected' = valid after correction. 'contested' = has unresolved issues. 'rejected' = invalid/incorrect. 'deferred' = needs more information.

correction.description: If result is 'corrected', describe what was changed.

comment.description: Free-text validation notes, reasoning, or open questions.

relatedDecisionId.description: ID of a DecisionTrace triggered by this validation (if applicable).

examples.targetName: Quote — gouvernance sur l'infrastructure conflictuelle et polycentrique
examples.comment: Verbatim match verified against PDF p.336.
